stories.title: Trump nominates Natalie Baker for US ambassador to Pakistan
stories.brief: US President Donald Trump has nominated Natalie Baker, the current charge d’affaires at the US embassy in Islamabad, to be the ambassador to Pakistan, according to a statement by the White House. She had arrived in Islamabad as deputy chief of mission in August 2024, according to details available on the embassy’s website.

stories.title: Trump nominates Natalie Baker as next US ambassador to Pakistan
stories.brief: US President Donald Trump nominated chargé d’affaires Natalie A Baker as the next US ambassador to Pakistan, paving the way for the appointment of a permanent envoy to Islamabad after a gap of nearly two years, it emerged on Tuesday.

stories.title: Cricket Australia chief rules out reopening 'sandpapergate' probe
